fields.title: Hurricane Marlena Local Statement Advisory Number 12
fields.office: National Weather Service Lake Charles LA AL042026

sections.heading: NEW INFORMATION
sections.text: A Hurricane Warning and a Storm Surge Warning have been issued for the coast of Haldane Parish.

sections.heading: WATCHES AND WARNINGS
sections.text: A Hurricane Warning and a Storm Surge Warning are in effect for Haldane Parish. Tropical storm conditions are expected to begin early Thursday.

sections.heading: SITUATION OVERVIEW
sections.text: Hurricane Marlena is moving north at 10 mph and is forecast to make landfall late Thursday.

sections.heading: POTENTIAL IMPACTS
sections.text: WIND: Extensive damage to roofs and trees. SURGE: Life-threatening inundation of 6 to 9 feet above ground. FLOODING RAIN: 8 to 12 inches. TORNADOES: A few possible.

sections.heading: PRECAUTIONARY/PREPAREDNESS ACTIONS
sections.text: Complete evacuations in surge zones A and B by sunset Wednesday. Follow instructions from local officials.

sections.heading: NEXT UPDATE
sections.text: The next local statement will be issued by 1000 PM CDT.
